page_title: WER 2-4 MON | Werder Bremen v B. Monchengladbach 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Timo Gerach has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Werder Bremen.
90+2' RED CARD! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Timo Gerach. He can have an early bath.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The linesman raises his flag. Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.
90' Today's match ends for Philipp Sander who will be replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
90' The corner kick from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
87' Timo Gerach blows his whistle and it's Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
86' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
84' Alassane Plea comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
82' A substitution has been made. Oliver Burke is replaced by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) replaces Issa Kabore.
82' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Milos Veljkovic is replaced by Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen).

81' 2 - 4 Alassane Plea sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:4.
80' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.

77' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Timo Gerach with no other option than to blow for a foul.
75' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is caught offside!
71' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Jonas Omlin will be replaced by Tiago Pereira Cardoso (B. Monchengladbach).
70' Jonas Omlin (B. Monchengladbach) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' Substitution. Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) in, Lukas Ullrich out.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) is coming onto the pitch as Nathan Ngoumou cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Senne Lynen and he is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
67' Substitution. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Andre Silva walks off.
63' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.

62' Crossbar! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
59' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Timo Gerach saw the whole situation.

54' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the bottom right corner. Michael Zetterer is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.
53' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.
53' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
50' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough challenge and Timo Gerach blows his whistle for an infringement.
47' 2 - 3 Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45+1' 2 - 2 Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) steps up to take the penalty and converts it with a shot into the middle of the goal.
45+1' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) is going to take the penalty!
45+1' It’s a PENALTY to Werder Bremen after the VAR review!
45+1' There's a break in play and referee Timo Gerach must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Werder Bremen using VAR. This could be interesting!
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Surely that's handball by one of the B. Monchengladbach players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
44' Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
44' A pass lands at the feet of Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
40' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
39' 1 - 2 Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick with a powerful low drive that goes inside the right-hand post and ends up behind the goalkeeper. A real jaw dropper!
38' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) tackles a bit over-zealously and Timo Gerach blows for a foul. Werder Bremen have a free kick.
35' The game is interrupted as Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) is flagged offside.
34' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
33' A cross from Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
32' The free kick from long range, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
31' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Timo Gerach blows for a foul.
28' 0 - 2 Goal! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
27' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
27' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
25' Golden chance! Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.

22' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
21' The main referee, Timo Gerach, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is given a yellow card for dissent.
19' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
17' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Crossbar! Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
13' What a chance that is! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
11' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Michael Zetterer to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
6' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
6' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

6' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Timo Gerach blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. PENALTY to B. Monchengladbach! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
4' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
3' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) was too forceful with his tackle and Timo Gerach interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
B. Monchengladbach will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Timo Gerach.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
Show lineups
